events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, famously playing The Buggles' "Video Killed the Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Remember the moment music TV changed forever? On this day, MTV burst onto screens, kicking off with a truly iconic track.

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album "Definitely Maybe" on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped their debut, 'Definitely Maybe'. Still sounds as fresh and anthemic today, doesn't it?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, "3 Days of Peace & Music," took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: On this day in '69, the first chords of Woodstock rang out. A truly defining moment for a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll today. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll through the decades.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, tragically passed away on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, a voice that shaped a generation and whose words still resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: We pay tribute to guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we honour the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar wizardry continues to inspire and electrify.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic "Abbey Road" album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, that unforgettable music. Celebrating The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as fiercely as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Wonder if he's celebrating with a cuppa or something stronger?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless single "Imagine" in the UK on October 24, 1975, though the album came out in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: A song that continues to inspire hope and unity. We're celebrating the anniversary of John Lennon's 'Imagine'.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember carrying your entire music library in your pocket? Today marks the anniversary of the revolutionary first iPod.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, "Dr. No," on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred, and always on time. Happy James Bond Day to all 007 fans!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon – a true icon whose message of peace and love still resonates.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, universally known as "The White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us a blank canvas of sound. Celebrating the anniversary of 'The White Album'.
